cohort: 58 full-term primiparous pregnant women with PROM and 38 full-term primiparous pregnant women without PROM (control group)
finding: Levels of IL-6, IL-8, and VCAM-1 in maternal serum, amniotic fluid, and cord blood were significantly higher in the PROM group compared to the control group, and increased with duration of membrane rupture in the PROM group.
